bibl.seg: Willy Clarysse & Christelle Fischer-Bovet, Greek Papyri of the Classics Department at Stanford (P. Stan. Class.). Part II.
bibl.note: Suite de: Willy Clarysse & Christelle Fischer-Bovet, Greek Papyri of the Classics Department at Stanford (P. Stan. Class.). Part I, JJurP 42 (2012) pp. 31-87, figg. - General introduction. - List of texts published in Part II. - Petitions: 33. P. Stan. Class. inv. 17 + 37. Petition to the oikonomos Apollonios by the oil seller Petoys (upper part of P. Köln VI, 261). Oxyrhyncha, 213 BC, 11 March; - 34. Inv. 5. Petition to the oikonomos Poseidonios. Mouchis (?), 217-215 BC; - 35. Inv. 7. Draft of a petition about effraction at night. Arsinoite nome, third century BC; - 36. Inv. 15. End of a petition to the king and queen? Arsinoite nome, second century BC; - 37. Inv. 33. End of a petition. Arsinoite nome, second century BC. - Letters: 38. Inv. 3. Official letter reporting a higher bid concerning the beer tax. Mouchis & Oxyrhyncha, 8 January 238 BC or 2 January 213 BC; - 39. Inv. 4. Official letter with report, followed by an account. Lysimachis, late third century BC; - 40. Inv. 11. Declaration of surety with royal oath. Arsinoite nome (?), 17-27 April 227 BC; - 41. Inv. 12. Official letter. Arsinoite nome (?), 15 May 212 BC or 21 May 237 BC; - 42. Inv. 25 recto. Letter or report with account of grain on the verso. Arsinoite nome (?), second half of the third century BC (?); - 43. Inv. 25 verso. Account of grain on the verso of a letter or report. Arsinoite nome (?), second half of the third century BC (?); - 44. Inv. 8. Letter to donkey drivers. Arsinoite nome, near Eleusis, second half of the third century BC; - 45. Inv. 10. Letter. Arsinoite nome (?), second half of the third century BC (?); - 46. Inv. 28. Letter (?). Arsinoite nome (?), second half of the third century BC (?); - 47. Inv. 39. Letter. Arsinoite nome (?), second half of the third century BC (?); - 48. Inv. 20. Letter. Arsinoite nome (?), late third century or early second century BC.
